facts.fact: 距那一夜已过十天，他视之为人生最棒的一夜。
facts.anchor: Ten since the night that might very well go down in history as the best of my life. The best night. The best sex. The single greatest moment.

facts.fact: Ruth 请 Ash/Talia/Ellison 来家晚餐，三个男孩到 Jody 家喝啤酒烧烤。
facts.anchor: this week, Ruth has invited Ash, Talia, and Ellison over for a little dinner party, and Ev decided it was in his best interest to leave them to it, so he, Jody, and I are all at Jody’s place.

facts.fact: Ev 问起「你和我妹在城里吃午饭」的传闻。
facts.anchor: “What’s this I hear about you and my sister and lunch in town?”

facts.fact: 他解释：她带 EJ 骑马，他马厩碰上后带她们去 Miss Celia 吃午饭。
facts.anchor: She took EJ riding. I met ‘em at the stables after, thought I’d take ‘em out for lunch. Went to Miss Celia’s.

facts.fact: 到家刷两遍牙、漱两口漱口水，抓起爆米花赶去她小屋。
facts.anchor: I brush my teeth twice when I get home just in case—I don’t even want to breathe shellfish near her—and rinse twice more with mouthwash, before grabbing a package of microwave popcorn.

facts.fact: 开演半小时后他完全没在看电影，只顾听她说话。
facts.anchor: Half an hour later, I have no idea what we’re watching. There’s a detective and some animals, but I’m far too busy hanging on to every word Ashton says

facts.fact: 她感叹失去外公的不止一家，牧场上下都爱他到最后。
facts.anchor: “Me too,” she sighs. “Sometimes I forget it ain’t just us who lost him. It’s all of us. Everyone on this ranch knew him, everyone worked for him. Loved him. Right up til the end.”

facts.fact: 他吻她额头说她是他名单第一名，与她在一起是此生最骄傲的事。
facts.anchor: “You’ll be number one on my list.” I kiss her forehead and she grins. “Proudest thing I ever did was get my head out of my ass and be with you.”
